answer: No agent's attestations count until it posts a 3,000 POA settlement anchor, locked until four epochs after its last countersignature. Unbonding then enters a two-epoch glacier queue, during which any established miner may post a 1,000 POA basalt challenge deposit and show a second live key under the same operator — shared funding parent, reused nonce, or duplicated hardware quote. A confirmed match slashes the anchor and pays the challenger a 20% bonus from the slash; a failed challenge burns the deposit. Rotation dies because exit takes six epochs and a proven twin costs the entire bond.
